article.title: Why Customer Growth Can Hide Weak Retention
article.why: Separate customer stock growth into acquisition and churn to understand growth quality.
article.author: OpenAI learning editor

sources.label: Background: customer retention and cohort analysis

paragraphs.en:
A growing customer base looks healthy at first glance. If a company had one million customers last year and 1.1 million this year, managers may naturally conclude that the business is strengthening. Yet the ending customer count combines several different flows. Strong acquisition can hide weak retention.

Think of the customer base as a stock. The opening stock changes when new customers enter and existing customers leave. A simple relationship is: ending customers = opening customers + new customers − churned customers. Because both acquisition and churn affect the same ending number, looking only at net growth can hide very different business conditions.

Suppose Company A starts with 1,000 customers, acquires 150, and loses 50. It ends with 1,100. Company B also starts with 1,000 and ends with 1,100, but it acquires 400 and loses 300. The headline growth is identical: 10 percent. Operationally, however, the businesses are very different. Company B must replace a large number of departing customers simply to achieve the same net result.

This matters because acquisition is often costly. Advertising, sales incentives, introductory discounts, and onboarding all consume resources. If customers leave quickly, a company can appear to grow while repeatedly paying to refill a leaking bucket. Customer lifetime value may be weak even when the total customer count rises.

Retention should therefore be measured directly. Depending on the business, analysts may track retained customers, churn rate, renewal rate, repeat-purchase rate, or cohort retention. Cohort analysis is especially useful because it asks what proportion of customers acquired in a particular period remain active after one month, six months, or a year.

Definitions must be clear. A customer who has not purchased for thirty days may be inactive in one business but perfectly normal in another. Subscription cancellation is easier to define than churn in occasional retail purchasing. Analysts should choose an inactivity window that reflects the natural purchase cycle.

Composition also matters. A company may acquire many low-value customers while losing fewer but highly valuable long-term customers. Customer counts would not reveal the economic damage. Segmenting retention by tenure, value, channel, or acquisition source can expose this problem.

A useful management report therefore shows the opening base, acquisitions, reactivations if relevant, churn, and ending base. It can then add retention rates and cohort curves. This stock-flow view turns “customers grew by 10 percent” into a more informative explanation of how growth happened.

Growth is strongest when acquisition adds to a durable base rather than continually replacing losses. The ending customer count is an important outcome, but it is not a diagnosis. To understand the quality of growth, teams need to see both the customers coming through the front door and those quietly leaving through the back.
paragraphs.zh: 顧客總數增加不一定代表 retention 改善。期末顧客數其實是期初顧客、新增顧客與流失顧客共同作用的結果。兩家公司都可能成長 10%，但一家只流失少量顧客，另一家卻必須大量獲客來填補大量 churn。後者可能付出更高 acquisition cost，且 lifetime value 較差。因此報告應把 opening base、acquisition、reactivation、churn、ending base 分開，並搭配 cohort retention。還要明確定義何謂流失，並依 tenure、value、channel 等切分，避免總人數掩蓋高價值客流失。
paragraphs.ja: 顧客数の増加だけではリテンション改善とは言えません。期末顧客数は、期初顧客、新規獲得、離脱の結果です。同じ10％成長でも、少数の離脱で成長した企業と、大量獲得で大量離脱を補った企業では成長の質が異なります。期初、新規、再活性化、離脱、期末を分け、コホート別の継続率も確認すると、顧客基盤が本当に強くなっているかを判断しやすくなります。

vocabulary.usage: Measure retention separately from total customer growth.
Strong acquisition can hide weak retention.
Track churn as a separate customer flow.
Use cohort analysis to compare retention over time.
Healthy acquisition adds to a durable customer base.
Separate reactivation from truly new acquisition.
Choose an inactivity window that fits the purchase cycle.

phrases.explanation: 比喻企業不斷獲客卻同時大量流失。
phrases.example: High acquisition can refill a leaking bucket without fixing retention.

grammar.title: even when
grammar.body: 表示即使某條件成立，另一個表面上矛盾的狀況仍可能存在，例如：Lifetime value may be weak even when customer count rises.

business.term: Let’s separate net growth into acquisition and churn.
business.explanation: 把淨成長拆成流入與流出。
business.example: Before celebrating the headline number, let’s separate net growth into acquisition and churn.

business.term: What does retention look like by cohort?
business.explanation: 要求以 cohort 檢查留存品質。
business.example: The total base is growing, but what does retention look like by cohort?

quiz.question: Why can two companies with the same customer growth rate have very different business health?
quiz.answer: One may retain most existing customers while the other relies on expensive acquisition to replace heavy churn.
